Polisa w mailu. Instrukcja w folderze. F: The insurance policy sits in an inbox. The manual in a folder. The invoice in some cloud drive. Cameras live in their own app, devices in another, and the inspection date — somewhere in someone's memory.

You manage it from one place.

You know what is happening at home.

You ask in your own words.

Knowledge about your home stays at home.

To opis wizji docelowej. Obecny zakres p: This describes the target vision. The current scope of work is Home Memory: people, homes, objects, documents, OCR, search, deadlines and reminders. The remaining pillars are a direction of development, not working features.
Centralną jednostką HomeIntelCore jest o: The central unit of HomeIntelCore is the object. Documents, deadlines and relationships gather around the things you know from everyday life.
Osoba, dom, pomieszczenie, pojazd, zwier: A person, home, room, vehicle, pet, device, service or organisation — one shared model, different meanings. This is why the system is not a file store: it understands what the stored information is about.
The memory of the home is built first. Paperless-ngx reads the document, Core links it to an object, and search brings the information back when it is needed.

Plan sieci domowej HomeIntelCore: router: The HomeIntelCore home network plan: a MikroTik RB5009 router, a CRS310-8G+2S+IN switch, a patch panel, an SFP+ link to the server, plus the segmentation concept and remote access over WireGuard.
Fizyczne połączenia odpowiadają na pytan: Physical connections answer the question: what do we plug in, and where? Logical segmentation describes the roles of devices. These are two separate views of the same network — for now, as a plan.
RB5009 and CRS310 as the distribution point.
Router MikroTik RB5009 łączy się przez p: The MikroTik RB5009 router connects through a patch panel to the main CRS310-8G+2S+IN switch. The switch provides eight 2.5G RJ45 ports and two SFP+ ports, one of which leads to the HomeIntelCore / NAS server.
Plan przewiduje dziewięć zakończeń RJ45,: The plan calls for nine RJ45 terminations, while the CRS310 provides eight RJ45 ports. One termination must therefore stay a spare, or be served by an additional small managed switch.
Internet prowadzi do routera MikroTik RB: The internet feeds the MikroTik RB5009 router, which connects through a patch panel to the main CRS310-8G+2S+IN switch. The switch distributes connections to the rooms and to the planned access points downstairs and upstairs. In Room 1 a separate SFP+ link connects the switch to the HomeIntelCore / NAS server. This is a cabling plan, not a completed installation.
To plan okablowania, a nie potwierdzenie: This is a cabling plan, not confirmation of a completed installation. The access points downstairs and upstairs are planned. No service is exposed publicly.
Planowane zakończenia okablowania w pomi: Planned cabling terminations in the rooms
Łącznie plan przewiduje dziewięć zakończ: In total the plan calls for nine RJ45 terminations plus one SFP+ link to the server. The CRS310-8G+2S+IN has eight RJ45 ports, so one termination must stay a spare or be served by an additional small managed switch. Connecting the router to the switch requires a separately assigned port. Port numbers, SFP+ modules and the uplink medium have not been determined yet.
Identyfikatory VLAN, podsieci, przypisan: VLAN IDs, subnets, port assignments and firewall rules have not been finally determined. The split into segments alone does not define what traffic is allowed between them.
HomeIntelCore jest projektowany do pracy: HomeIntelCore is designed to run on the LAN. The CRS310 → SFP+ → server link marks out the path to services and local data, without claiming throughput that has not been measured.
Zdalny dostęp jest osobną, kontrolowaną: Remote access is a separate, controlled VPN layer, ultimately based on WireGuard. Home services are not, and are not meant to be, exposed publicly. The specific configuration and security rules remain part of the deployment.
